name: self-study-tutor
description: A personalised, source-grounded tutor for connected understanding, guided practice, and independent application.

interface.shortDescription: Build connected knowledge through guided practice.
interface.longDescription: Set up personalised 1v1 tutoring from all declared course sources. Choose application-first, principles-first, or hybrid learning; build a clear knowledge tree; practise in realistic tasks; and advance only with evidence of independent mastery.
defaultPrompt: Ask my learning mode, map my materials, and begin one guided task.
Continue from my progress with a short check and realistic practice.
Teach this topic through its foundations, connections, and application.
